excerpt: Semgrep is a code security platform built on an open-source static analysis engine: SAST, dependency (SCA) and secrets scanning with AI triage. Free for small teams; raised a $100M Series D in 2025.
content:
Semgrep is an application security platform that scans source code for vulnerabilities. It grew out of an open-source static analysis engine, also called Semgrep, which developers can extend with their own rules. The commercial platform adds three main products: Semgrep Code for static application security testing (SAST), Semgrep Supply Chain for finding vulnerable or malicious open-source dependencies, and Semgrep Secrets for hard-coded credentials. Newer products include Semgrep Guardian, which scans AI-generated code as it is written, and AI-powered detection, triage and suggested fixes. Its About page says it has powered more than 75 million source-code security scans.

Semgrep was founded in 2017 by Drew Dennison, Isaac Evans and Luke O'Malley, according to its About page; Isaac Evans is CEO. In February 2025 the company announced a $100 million Series D led by Menlo Ventures, with existing investors Felicis Ventures, Harpoon Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures and Sequoia Capital participating. Crunchbase News reported that it was the largest round of the year so far in application security, and that Semgrep had raised $204 million in total, according to the company.

Semgrep publishes its prices. The Free edition covers up to 10 repositories and 10 contributors and includes Code and Supply Chain scanning plus a small number of AI credits. The Teams plan is priced per contributor per month: $30 for Code, $30 for Supply Chain and $15 for Secrets, and adds cross-file analysis with Pro rules, more AI credits and single sign-on. Enterprise pricing is custom. The open-source Community Edition engine remains free to run yourself.

This profile draws on Semgrep's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.

profile.platform: Cloud platform, CLI and CI/CD; open-source engine
profile.starts_at: Free for up to 10 contributors; Teams from $15/contributor/month
profile.summary_short: Code, dependency and secrets scanning with AI triage, built on an open-source static analysis engine

gallery.alt: Semgrep logo, three linked green rings and the word Semgrep, on a dark navy background with green line patterns in the corners

use_cases: Scanning source code for security bugs in pull requests and CI
Finding vulnerable or malicious open-source dependencies
Detecting hard-coded secrets such as API keys
Writing custom rules to enforce a team's own coding standards
Triaging and fixing findings with AI assistance

fit: run application security or platform engineering for a software team
want developer-friendly scanning that runs in pull requests
want to write custom rules, or start free with a small team
not_fit: need dynamic testing of running applications (DAST) rather than code scanning
have no access to your application's source code

pricing.intro: Prices from Semgrep's official pricing page, per contributor per month.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: Up to 10 repositories and 10 contributors; Code and Supply Chain; 60 AI credits

plans.name: Teams: Code (SAST)
plans.detail: Cross-file analysis with Pro rules, AI triage, SSO

notes: The open-source Semgrep Community Edition engine is free to self-run.

pros: Free tier for small teams and a free open-source engine
Custom rules for a team's own standards
cons: Costs scale with the number of contributors
Static analysis only; pair with other tools for runtime testing

alternatives.intro: Other code security scanners. We have not compared them hands-on.

items.name: Snyk
items.what: Developer security platform for code, dependencies, containers and IaC
items.difference: Broader coverage of containers and infrastructure as code.

items.name: GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL)
items.what: Code scanning, secret scanning and dependency review in GitHub
items.difference: Built into GitHub; CodeQL queries are more complex to write.

items.name: SonarQube
items.difference: Combines code quality metrics with security checks.

faq.a: The open-source Community Edition is free, and the hosted Free edition covers up to 10 repositories and 10 contributors. Paid Teams plans are per contributor.
Teams pricing is $30 per contributor per month for Code, $30 for Supply Chain and $15 for Secrets, per its pricing page. Enterprise is custom.
Drew Dennison, Isaac Evans and Luke O'Malley, in 2017. Isaac Evans is CEO.

faq.q: How much funding has Semgrep raised?
faq.a: $204 million in total, including a $100 million Series D led by Menlo Ventures in February 2025, according to Crunchbase News.
